ko.title: 100개 표적, 유조선 2척: 한 달여 만에 가장 격렬했던 미-이란 교전의 내막

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation Around the Strait of Hormuz
segments.tr: ## 호르무즈 해협 주변의 급격한 긴장 고조

segments.src: Tensions between the United States and Iran flared sharply this week in what analysts describe as the most intense military exchange between the two sides in more than a month.
segments.tr: 이번 주 미국과 이란 간의 긴장이 급격히 고조된 가운데, 분석가들은 이를 한 달여 만에 양측 사이에 벌어진 가장 격렬한 군사 교전으로 평가하고 있습니다.

segments.src: According to statements from defense officials, US forces conducted a wide-ranging series of strikes against sites linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports citing close to 100 separate targets.
segments.tr: 국방 당국자들의 발표에 따르면, 미군은 호르무즈 해협 인근에서 이란 이슬람혁명수비대(IRGC)와 연계된 시설에 대해 광범위한 일련의 타격을 감행했으며, 보고서에 따르면 별도의 표적이 100개 가까이 이릅니다.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the operation say the strikes notably included, for the first time in this round of hostilities, vessels identified as Iranian government-affiliated tankers.
segments.tr: 작전을 잘 아는 당국자들은 이번 타격에 특히 이번 교전 국면 최초로 이란 정부 연계 유조선으로 확인된 선박들이 포함되었다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: The inclusion of maritime targets marks a departure from previous exchanges, which had largely focused on land-based military infrastructure, and has drawn attention from energy markets and shipping industry observers given the strait's role as a critical corridor for global oil transit.
segments.tr: 해상 표적이 포함된 것은 주로 지상 군사 인프라에 집중되었던 이전 교전들과는 다른 양상을 보이며, 호르무즈 해협이 글로벌 석유 수송의 핵심 통로라는 점을 고려할 때 에너지 시장과 해운업계 관측통들의 주목을 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## 이란의 대응

segments.src: In the hours that followed, Iranian forces reportedly launched a combination of ballistic missiles and drones toward US-linked military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: 이후 몇 시간 동안 이란군은 요르단, 쿠웨이트, 바레인에 위치한 미군 연계 군사 시설을 향해 탄도미사일과 드론을 혼합하여 발사한 것으로 알려졌습니다.

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.
segments.tr: 역내 당국자들은 이에 대응해 방공 시스템이 작동되었다고 밝혔으나, 피해나 인명 손실을 포함한 결과의 전체 세부 사항은 본 기사 작성 시점까지 독립적으로 확인되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: 이란 관영 매체는 이번 대응을 보복 차원이라 규정하며 국가 주권 수호로 포장한 반면, 미 당국자들은 자신들의 초기 타격이 선박 운항과 역내 안정을 위협하는 데 사용되어 온 군사 인프라를 겨냥한 표적 행동이었다고 설명했습니다.

segments.src: As with prior escalations, both sides' public accounts diverge, and independent confirmation of specific claims remains limited.
segments.tr: 이전의 긴장 고조 때와 마찬가지로 양측의 공식 발표는 엇갈리고 있으며, 특정 주장에 대한 독립적인 확인은 여전히 제한적입니다.

segments.src: ## Why This Round Feels Different
segments.tr: ## 이번 국면이 다르게 느껴지는 이유

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:
segments.tr: 분석가들은 7월 말 이후의 이전 교전들과 이번 교전을 구별 짓는 두 가지 요인을 지적합니다.

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **타격 규모.** 보고된 약 100개 시설이라는 숫자는 전형적으로 더 좁은 범위의 표적을 다루었던 이전 국면들에 비해 상당한 확장을 의미합니다.

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **해상 차원.** 정부 연계 유조선 타격은 새로운 전선을 형성하며, 이는 전 세계 해상 석유 수송량의 상당 부분이 통과하는 물길인 호르무즈 해협을 통한 항행의 자유에 직접적인 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: 이란의 대응으로 타격을 받은 것으로 알려진 기지들을 보유한 국가들을 포함한 역내 정부들은 자제를 촉구하고 양측 모두 추가적인 긴장 고조를 피할 것을 요구했습니다.

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: 걸프 국가 중재자들이 참여하는 채널을 포함한 외교적 채널들이 가동 중인 것으로 전해졌으나, 휴전 틀이 공개적으로 확인되지는 않았습니다.

segments.src: ## Market and Regional Ripple Effects
segments.tr: ## 시장 및 역내 파급 효과

segments.src: Energy markets moved on the news, with oil prices seeing renewed volatility amid concerns over potential disruptions to shipping through Hormuz, a chokepoint that has repeatedly drawn global attention during past periods of US-Iran tension.
segments.tr: 과거 미-이란 긴장 국면마다 전 세계의 주목을 받아온 요충지인 호르무즈 해협을 통한 선박 운항 차질 우려 속에 유가가 다시 변동성을 보이면서 에너지 시장이 움직였습니다.

segments.src: Shipping insurers and logistics firms operating in the Gulf are reportedly reassessing risk premiums for vessels transiting the strait.
segments.tr: 걸프 지역에서 활동하는 해운 보험사와 물류 기업들은 해협을 통과하는 선박에 대한 위험 프리미엄을 재평가하고 있는 것으로 알려졌습니다.

segments.src: Regional capitals, wary of being drawn further into the confrontation, have emphasized that their territories and bases should not become recurring flashpoints.
segments.tr: 분쟁에 더 깊이 말려드는 것을 경계하는 역내 수도들은 자신들의 영토와 기지가 반복적인 분쟁 지역이 되어서는 안 된다고 강조했습니다.

segments.src: Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan have not issued unified public statements beyond confirming that air defense protocols were activated.
segments.tr: 쿠웨이트, 바레인, 요르단은 방공 프로토콜이 작동되었음을 확인한 것 외에 통일된 공공 성명을 발표하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 관전 포인트

segments.src: With both Washington and Tehran signaling they view their recent actions as proportionate responses rather than the opening moves of a broader campaign, attention now turns to whether this exchange represents a peak or merely a pause.
segments.tr: 워싱턴과 테헤란 모두 최근의 행동을 더 광범위한 작전의 시작이 아닌 비례적인 대응으로 보고 있다는 신호를 보내면서, 이제 관심은 이번 교전이 정점을 찍은 것인지 아니면 단지 일시적인 소강상태인지에 쏠리고 있습니다.

segments.src: Key indicators to watch include:
segments.tr: 주시해야 할 주요 지표는 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: - Whether shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continues without further incident
segments.tr: - 호르무즈 해협을 통한 선박 통항이 추가 사건 없이 계속되는지 여부

segments.src: - Any statements from Gulf Cooperation Council members regarding regional security coordination
segments.tr: - 역내 안보 공조와 관련한 걸프협력회의(GCC) 회원국들의 성명 여부

segments.src: - Diplomatic signals from Washington and Tehran in the coming days
segments.tr: - 향후 며칠간 워싱턴과 테헤란이 보낼 외교적 신호

segments.src: As with previous flare-ups, the situation remains fluid, and official casualty figures, damage assessments and strategic intentions on both sides are likely to be revised as more verified information becomes available.
segments.tr: 이전의 긴장 고조 때와 마찬가지로 상황은 가변적이며, 교증된 정보가 더 많이 확보됨에 따라 양측의 공식 인명 피해 집계, 피해 평가 및 전략적 의도는 수정될 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: Readers are encouraged to follow updates from established wire services for the latest confirmed developments.
segments.tr: 독자들께서는 검증된 최신 소식을 확인하기 위해 주요 통신사의 업데이트를 계속 팔로우하시기를 권장합니다.

zh.title: 100个目标、两艘油轮：一个多月来美伊最大规模交火内幕

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation Around the Strait of Hormuz
segments.tr: ## 霍尔兹海峡周边急剧升级

segments.src: Tensions between the United States and Iran flared sharply this week in what analysts describe as the most intense military exchange between the two sides in more than a month.
segments.tr: 本周美伊两国紧张局势急剧升温，分析人士称这是双方一个多月来最激烈的军事交锋。

segments.src: According to statements from defense officials, US forces conducted a wide-ranging series of strikes against sites linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports citing close to 100 separate targets.
segments.tr: 根据国防官员的声明，美军在霍尔木兹海峡附近对与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）有关的地点进行了范围广泛的一系列打击，据报道目标近100个。

segments.src: Officials familiar with the operation say the strikes notably included, for the first time in this round of hostilities, vessels identified as Iranian government-affiliated tankers.
segments.tr: 熟悉该行动的官员表示，此次打击值得注意的是，在此轮敌对行动中首次将识别为伊朗政府所属的油轮纳入其中。

segments.src: The inclusion of maritime targets marks a departure from previous exchanges, which had largely focused on land-based military infrastructure, and has drawn attention from energy markets and shipping industry observers given the strait's role as a critical corridor for global oil transit.
segments.tr: 将海上目标纳入其中标志着与以往交火的不同，以往交火主要集中在陆基军事基础设施上，鉴于该海峡作为全球石油运输关键走廊的作用，此举已引起能源市场和航运业观察人士的关注。

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## 伊朗的回应

segments.src: In the hours that followed, Iranian forces reportedly launched a combination of ballistic missiles and drones toward US-linked military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: 据报道，在随后的几个小时里，伊朗军队向位于约旦、科威特和巴林的美方相关军事设施发射了弹道导弹和无人机的组合攻击。

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.
segments.tr: 地区官员表示防空系统已启动响应，尽管截至撰写本文时，包括任何损失或人员伤亡在内的结果完整细节尚未得到独立核实。

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: 伊朗官方媒体将此次回应定性为报复性行动，称其为捍卫国家主权的防御，而美国官员则将最初的打击描述为针对据称被用于威胁航运和地区稳定的军事基础设施的定向打击。

segments.src: As with prior escalations, both sides' public accounts diverge, and independent confirmation of specific claims remains limited.
segments.tr: 与以往局势升级一样，双方的公开说法存在分歧，对具体说法的独立确认仍然有限。

segments.src: ## Why This Round Feels Different
segments.tr: ## 为什么这轮交锋感觉不同

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:
segments.tr: 分析人士指出了使此次交锋与7月下旬以来早期交锋不同的两个因素：

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **打击规模。** 据报道约100个地点的数字与以往几轮相比显著扩大，以往几轮通常涉及较少的目标。

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **海上维度。** 打击政府关联油轮开辟了一个新战线，直接触及了霍尔木兹海峡的航行自由，这是一条通过全球相当大比例海上石油的水道。

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: 地区政府（包括那些主办了据报道遭到伊朗回应打击的基地的政府）呼吁克制，敦促双方避免进一步升级。

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: 据说包括海湾调解人在内的外交渠道正在积极活动，但尚未公开确认任何停火框架。

segments.src: ## Market and Regional Ripple Effects
segments.tr: ## 市场和地区涟漪效应

segments.src: Energy markets moved on the news, with oil prices seeing renewed volatility amid concerns over potential disruptions to shipping through Hormuz, a chokepoint that has repeatedly drawn global attention during past periods of US-Iran tension.
segments.tr: 能源市场对这一消息做出反应，由于担心通过霍尔木兹海峡的航运可能受到干扰，油价再度出现波动，该海峡在过去美伊紧张时期曾多次吸引全球关注。

segments.src: Shipping insurers and logistics firms operating in the Gulf are reportedly reassessing risk premiums for vessels transiting the strait.
segments.tr: 据报道，在海湾地区运营的航运保险公司和物流公司正在重新评估通过该海峡船只的风险溢价。

segments.src: Regional capitals, wary of being drawn further into the confrontation, have emphasized that their territories and bases should not become recurring flashpoints.
segments.tr: 地区各国首都警惕被进一步卷入对抗，强调其领土和基地不应成为反复爆发的冲突点。

segments.src: Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan have not issued unified public statements beyond confirming that air defense protocols were activated.
segments.tr: 科威特、巴林和约旦除了确认防空协议已启动外，未发表统一的公开声明。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来关注什么

segments.src: With both Washington and Tehran signaling they view their recent actions as proportionate responses rather than the opening moves of a broader campaign, attention now turns to whether this exchange represents a peak or merely a pause.
segments.tr: 随着华盛顿和德黑兰都表示他们将最近的行动视为相称的回应，而不是更广泛行动的开端，人们的注意力现在转向这场交锋是代表着顶峰还是仅仅是暂停。

segments.src: Key indicators to watch include:
segments.tr: 需要关注的关键指标包括：

segments.src: - Whether shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continues without further incident
segments.tr: - 通过霍尔木兹海峡的航运流量是否继续没有进一步的事故发生

segments.src: - Any statements from Gulf Cooperation Council members regarding regional security coordination
segments.tr: - 海湾阿拉伯国家合作委员会成员国关于地区安全协调的任何声明

segments.src: - Diplomatic signals from Washington and Tehran in the coming days
segments.tr: - 华盛顿和德黑兰在未来几天的外交信号

segments.src: As with previous flare-ups, the situation remains fluid, and official casualty figures, damage assessments and strategic intentions on both sides are likely to be revised as more verified information becomes available.
segments.tr: 与以往的摩擦一样，局势仍然充满变数，随着更多经过核实的信息的出现，双方的官方伤亡数字、损失评估和战略意图可能会被修正。

segments.src: Readers are encouraged to follow updates from established wire services for the latest confirmed developments.

segments.tr: ऑपरेशन से परिचित अधिकारियों का कहना है कि हमलों में विशेष रूप से, शत्रुता के इस दौर में पहली बार, ईरानी सरकार से संबद्ध टैंकरों के रूप में पहचाने जाने वाले जहाज शामिल थे।

segments.tr: समुद्री लक्ष्यों को शामिल करना पिछले आदान-प्रदानों से एक बदलाव का प्रतीक है, जो काफी हद तक भूमि-आधारित सैन्य बुनियादी ढांचे पर केंद्रित थे, और इसने ऊर्जा बाजारों और शिपिंग उद्योग के पर्यवेक्षकों का ध्यान आकर्षित किया है क्योंकि यह जलडमरूमध्य वैश्विक तेल पारगमन के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण गलियारे के रूप में कार्य करता है।

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## ईरान की प्रतिक्रिया

segments.src: In the hours that followed, Iranian forces reportedly launched a combination of ballistic missiles and drones toward US-linked military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: बाद के घंटों में, ईरानी बलों ने कथित तौर पर जॉर्डन, कुवैत और बहरीन में अमेरिकी-संबद्ध सैन्य प्रतिष्ठानों की ओर बैलिस्टिक मिसाइलों और ड्रोन का संयोजन लॉन्च किया।

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.
segments.tr: क्षेत्रीय अधिकारियों ने कहा कि प्रतिक्रिया में वायु रक्षा प्रणालियों को सक्रिय किया गया था, हालांकि किसी भी क्षति या हताहतों सहित परिणाम का पूरा विवरण, लेखन के समय तक स्वतंत्र रूप से सत्यापित नहीं किया गया है।

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: ईरानी राज्य मीडिया ने प्रतिक्रिया को प्रतिशोधात्मक बताया, इसे राष्ट्रीय संप्रभुता की रक्षा के रूप में तैयार किया, जबकि अमेरिकी अधिकारियों ने अपने शुरुआती हमलों को सैन्य बुनियादी ढांचे के खिलाफ लक्षित कार्रवाई के रूप में वर्णित किया, जिसे वे कहते हैं कि शिपिंग और क्षेत्रीय स्थिरता को खतरे में डालने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया गया है।

segments.src: As with prior escalations, both sides' public accounts diverge, and independent confirmation of specific claims remains limited.
segments.tr: पिछले तनावों की तरह, दोनों पक्षों के सार्वजनिक खाते अलग-अलग हैं, और विशिष्ट दावों की स्वतंत्र पुष्टि सीमित बनी हुई है।

segments.src: ## Why This Round Feels Different
segments.tr: ## यह दौर अलग क्यों लगता है

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:
segments.tr: विश्लेषक उन दो कारकों की ओर इशारा करते हैं जो इस आदान-प्रदान को जुलाई के अंत से पहले के आदान-प्रदानों से अलग करते हैं:

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **लक्ष्यीकरण का पैमाना।** लगभग 100 स्थलों का रिपोर्ट किया गया आंकड़ा पिछले दौरों की तुलना में एक महत्वपूर्ण विस्तार का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, जिसमें आमतौर पर लक्ष्यों का एक संकीर्ण सेट शामिल होता था।

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **समुद्री आयाम।** सरकार से जुड़े टैंकरों पर हमला करना एक नया मोर्चा खोलता है, जो सीधे होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य के माध्यम से नेविगेशन की स्वतंत्रता को छूता है, एक जलमार्ग जिसके माध्यम से दुनिया का एक बड़ा हिस्सा समुद्री तेल गुजरता है।

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: क्षेत्रीय सरकारों ने, जिनमें ईरान की प्रतिक्रिया द्वारा लक्षित आधारों की मेजबानी करने वाले भी शामिल हैं, संयम बरतने का आह्वान किया है और दोनों पक्षों से आगे के तनाव से बचने का आग्रह किया है।

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: राजनयिक चैनल, जिनमें खाड़ी मध्यस्थ शामिल हैं, सक्रिय बताए जाते हैं, हालांकि किसी भी युद्धविराम ढांचे की सार्वजनिक रूप से पुष्टि नहीं की गई है।

segments.src: ## Market and Regional Ripple Effects
segments.tr: ## बाजार और क्षेत्रीय प्रभाव

segments.src: Energy markets moved on the news, with oil prices seeing renewed volatility amid concerns over potential disruptions to shipping through Hormuz, a chokepoint that has repeatedly drawn global attention during past periods of US-Iran tension.
segments.tr: ऊर्जा बाजारों ने खबर पर प्रतिक्रिया दी, तेल की कीमतों में होर्मुज के माध्यम से शिपिंग में संभावित व्यवधानों की चिंताओं के बीच नई अस्थिरता देखी गई, एक ऐसा चोकपॉइंट जिसने पिछले अमेरिकी-ईरान तनाव के दौरान बार-बार वैश्विक ध्यान आकर्षित किया है।

segments.src: Shipping insurers and logistics firms operating in the Gulf are reportedly reassessing risk premiums for vessels transiting the strait.
segments.tr: खाड़ी में काम करने वाली शिपिंग बीमाकर्ता और लॉजिस्टिक्स कंपनियां कथित तौर पर जलडमरूमध्य से गुजरने वाले जहाजों के लिए जोखिम प्रीमियम का पुनर्मूल्यांकन कर रही हैं।

segments.src: Regional capitals, wary of being drawn further into the confrontation, have emphasized that their territories and bases should not become recurring flashpoints.
segments.tr: क्षेत्रीय राजधानियां, टकराव में और अधिक खींचे जाने के डर से, इस बात पर जोर दे रही हैं कि उनके क्षेत्र और आधार बार-बार फ्लैशपॉइंट नहीं बनने चाहिए।

segments.src: Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan have not issued unified public statements beyond confirming that air defense protocols were activated.
segments.tr: कुवैत, बहरीन और जॉर्डन ने यह पुष्टि करने के अलावा कि वायु रक्षा प्रोटोकॉल सक्रिय किए गए थे, कोई एकीकृत सार्वजनिक बयान जारी नहीं किया है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: With both Washington and Tehran signaling they view their recent actions as proportionate responses rather than the opening moves of a broader campaign, attention now turns to whether this exchange represents a peak or merely a pause.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन और तेहरान दोनों के यह संकेत देने के साथ कि वे अपनी हालिया कार्रवाइयों को व्यापक अभियान की शुरुआती चालों के बजाय आनुपातिक प्रतिक्रिया के रूप में देखते हैं, अब ध्यान इस बात पर है कि क्या यह आदान-प्रदान एक शिखर का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है या केवल एक विराम का।

segments.src: Key indicators to watch include:
segments.tr: देखने के लिए प्रमुख संकेतक शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - Whether shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continues without further incident
segments.tr: - क्या होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य के माध्यम से शिपिंग यातायात बिना किसी और घटना के जारी रहता है

segments.src: - Any statements from Gulf Cooperation Council members regarding regional security coordination
segments.tr: - क्षेत्रीय सुरक्षा समन्वय के संबंध में खाड़ी सहयोग परिषद के सदस्यों से कोई बयान

segments.src: - Diplomatic signals from Washington and Tehran in the coming days
segments.tr: - आने वाले दिनों में वाशिंगटन और तेहरान से राजनयिक संकेत

segments.src: As with previous flare-ups, the situation remains fluid, and official casualty figures, damage assessments and strategic intentions on both sides are likely to be revised as more verified information becomes available.
segments.tr: पिछले भड़कने की तरह, स्थिति तरल बनी हुई है, और दोनों पक्षों पर आधिकारिक हताहतों की संख्या, क्षति का आकलन और रणनीतिक इरादों को संशोधित किए जाने की संभावना है क्योंकि अधिक सत्यापित जानकारी उपलब्ध हो जाती है।

segments.src: Readers are encouraged to follow updates from established wire services for the latest confirmed developments.
segments.tr: पाठकों को नवीनतम पुष्टि किए गए विकास के लिए स्थापित वायर सेवाओं से अपडेट का पालन करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है।

es.title: 100 objetivos, dos petroleros: el intercambio más intenso entre EE. UU. e Irán en más de un mes

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation Around the Strait of Hormuz
segments.tr: ## Una fuerte escalada alrededor del estrecho de Ormuz

segments.src: Tensions between the United States and Iran flared sharply this week in what analysts describe as the most intense military exchange between the two sides in more than a month.
segments.tr: Las tensiones entre Estados Unidos e Irán aumentaron drásticamente esta semana en lo que los analistas describen como el intercambio militar más intenso entre ambas partes en más de un mes.

segments.src: According to statements from defense officials, US forces conducted a wide-ranging series of strikes against sites linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports citing close to 100 separate targets.
segments.tr: Según declaraciones de funcionarios de defensa, las fuerzas estadounidenses llevaron a cabo una amplia serie de ataques contra sitios vinculados al Cuerpo de la Guardia Revolucionaria Islámica (CGRI) de Irán cerca del estrecho de Ormuz, y los informes citan cerca de 100 objetivos separados.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the operation say the strikes notably included, for the first time in this round of hostilities, vessels identified as Iranian government-affiliated tankers.
segments.tr: Funcionarios familiarizados con la operación afirman que los ataques incluyeron notablemente, por primera vez en esta ronda de hostilidades, a embarcaciones identificadas como petroleros afiliados al gobierno iraní.

segments.src: The inclusion of maritime targets marks a departure from previous exchanges, which had largely focused on land-based military infrastructure, and has drawn attention from energy markets and shipping industry observers given the strait's role as a critical corridor for global oil transit.
segments.tr: La inclusión de objetivos marítimos marca un cambio respecto a intercambios anteriores, que se habían centrado en gran medida en infraestructura militar terrestre, y ha llamado la atención de los mercados energéticos y observadores de la industria naviera dado el papel del estrecho como un corredor crítico para el tránsito mundial de petróleo.

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## La respuesta de Irán

segments.src: In the hours that followed, Iranian forces reportedly launched a combination of ballistic missiles and drones toward US-linked military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: En las horas siguientes, las fuerzas iraníes presuntamente lanzaron una combinación de misiles balísticos y drones hacia instalaciones militares vinculadas a EE. UU. en Jordania, Kuwait y Baréin.

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.
segments.tr: Funcionarios regionales dijeron que los sistemas de defensa aérea se activaron en respuesta, aunque los detalles completos del resultado, incluidos los daños o bajas, no han sido verificados de forma independiente al momento de redactar este informe.

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: Los medios estatales iraníes caracterizaron la respuesta como de represalia, enmarcándola como una defensa de la soberanía nacional, mientras que los funcionarios estadounidenses describieron sus ataques iniciales como acciones dirigidas contra infraestructura militar que, según afirman, se ha utilizado para amenazar la navegación y la estabilidad regional.

segments.src: As with prior escalations, both sides' public accounts diverge, and independent confirmation of specific claims remains limited.
segments.tr: Al igual que con escaladas anteriores, las versiones públicas de ambas partes divergen y la confirmación independiente de afirmaciones específicas sigue siendo limitada.

segments.src: ## Why This Round Feels Different
segments.tr: ## Por qué esta ronda se siente diferente

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:
segments.tr: Los analistas señalan dos factores que distinguen este intercambio de los anteriores desde finales de julio:

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **Escala de los objetivos.** La cifra reportada de aproximadamente 100 sitios representa una expansión significativa en comparación con rondas anteriores, que típicamente involucraban un conjunto más reducido de objetivos.

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **Dimensión marítima.** Atacar petroleros vinculados al gobierno introduce un nuevo frente, uno que afecta directamente la libertad de navegación a través del estrecho de Ormuz, una vía fluvial por la cual pasa una parte sustancial del petróleo transportado por mar en el mundo.

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: Gobiernos regionales, incluidos aquellos que albergan las bases supuestamente atacadas por la respuesta de Irán, han pedido moderación y han instado a ambas partes a evitar una mayor escalada.

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: Se dice que los canales diplomáticos, incluidos los que involucran a mediadores del Golfo, están activos, aunque no se ha confirmado públicamente ningún marco de alto el fuego.

segments.src: ## Market and Regional Ripple Effects
segments.tr: ## Efectos dominó en el mercado y la región

segments.src: Energy markets moved on the news, with oil prices seeing renewed volatility amid concerns over potential disruptions to shipping through Hormuz, a chokepoint that has repeatedly drawn global attention during past periods of US-Iran tension.
segments.tr: Los mercados energéticos reaccionaron a la noticia; los precios del petróleo experimentaron una renovada volatilidad en medio de la preocupación por posibles interrupciones en el transporte marítimo a través de Ormuz, un punto de estrangulamiento que ha atraído repetidamente la atención mundial durante períodos pasados de tensión entre EE. UU. e Irán.

segments.src: Shipping insurers and logistics firms operating in the Gulf are reportedly reassessing risk premiums for vessels transiting the strait.
segments.tr: Las aseguradoras marítimas y las empresas de logística que operan en el Golfo están reevaluando las primas de riesgo para las embarcaciones que transitan por el estrecho.

segments.src: Regional capitals, wary of being drawn further into the confrontation, have emphasized that their territories and bases should not become recurring flashpoints.
segments.tr: Las capitales regionales, cautelosas de ser arrastradas aún más al enfrentamiento, han enfatizado que sus territorios y bases no deben convertirse en focos de conflicto recurrentes.

segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.tr: Dado que tanto Washington como Teherán indican que consideran sus acciones recientes como respuestas proporcionales en lugar de los movimientos iniciales de una campaña más amplia, la atención se centra ahora en si este intercambio representa un punto máximo o simplemente una pausa.

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation Around the Strait of Hormuz
segments.tr: ## تصعيد حاد حول مضيق هرمز

segments.src: Tensions between the United States and Iran flared sharply this week in what analysts describe as the most intense military exchange between the two sides in more than a month.
segments.tr: تصاعدت التوترات بين الولايات المتحدة وإيران بشكل حاد هذا الأسبوع فيما يصفه المحللون بأنه أعنف تبادل عسكري بين الجانبين منذ أكثر من شهر.

segments.src: According to statements from defense officials, US forces conducted a wide-ranging series of strikes against sites linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports citing close to 100 separate targets.
segments.tr: ووفقاً لتصريحات مسؤولي الدفاع، نفذت القوات الأمريكية سلسلة واسعة النطاق من الضربات ضد مواقع مرتبطة بالحرس الثوري الإسلامي الإيراني بالقرب من مضيق هرمز، حيث أشارت التقارير إلى استهداف ما يقرب من 100 هدف منفصل.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the operation say the strikes notably included, for the first time in this round of hostilities, vessels identified as Iranian government-affiliated tankers.
segments.tr: ويقول مسؤولون مطلعون على العملية إن الضربات شملت بشكل ملحوظ، ولأول مرة في هذه الجولة من الأعمال العدائية، سفناً تم تحديدها على أنها ناقلات تابعة للحكومة الإيرانية.

segments.src: The inclusion of maritime targets marks a departure from previous exchanges, which had largely focused on land-based military infrastructure, and has drawn attention from energy markets and shipping industry observers given the strait's role as a critical corridor for global oil transit.
segments.tr: ويمثل إدراج الأهداف البحرية تحولاً عن التبادلات السابقة، التي كانت تركز إلى حد كبير على البنية التحتية العسكرية البرية، وقد جذب انتباه أسواق الطاقة ومراقبي صناعة الشحن نظراً لدور المضيق كممر حيوي لنقل النفط العالمي.

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## رد إيران

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: وصفت وسائل الإعلام الرسمية الإيرانية الرد بأنه انتقامي، وصورته على أنه دفاع عن السيادة الوطنية، في حين وصف المسؤولون الأمريكيون ضرباتهم الأولية بأنها إجراءات موجهة ضد البنية التحتية العسكرية التي يقولون إنها استُخدمت لتهديد الشحن والاستقرار الإقليمي.

segments.tr: ## لماذا تبدو هذه الجولة مختلفة

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **نطاق الاستهداف.** يمثل الرقم المبلغ عنه والذي يبلغ حوالي 100 موقع توسعاً كبيراً مقارنة بالجولات السابقة، التي كانت تنطوي عادةً على مجموعة أضيق من الأهداف.

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **البعد البحري.** إن ضرب الناقلات المرتبطة بالحكومة يفتح جبهة جديدة، وهي جبهة تمس بشكل مباشر حرية الملاحة عبر مضيق هرمز، وهو ممر مائي تمر عبره نسبة كبيرة من النفط المنقول بحراً في العالم.

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: وقد دعت الحكومات الإقليمية، بما في ذلك تلك التي تستضيف القواعد التي قيل إنها استُهدفت برد إيران، إلى ضبط النفس وحثت الجانبين على تجنب المزيد من التصعيد.

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.

segments.tr: تحركت أسواق الطاقة بناءً على الأخبار، حيث شهدت أسعار النفط تقلبات متجددة وسط مخاوف بشأن اضطرابات محتملة في الشحن عبر هرمز، وهو نقطة اختناق جذبت مراراً وتكراراً اهتماماً عالمياً خلال فترات التوتر السابقة بين الولايات المتحدة وإيران.

segments.tr: وقد أكدت العواصم الإقليمية، التي تخشى الانجرار أكثر إلى المواجهة، أن أراضيها وقواعدها يجب ألا تصبح نقاط اشتعال متكررة.

fr.title: 100 cibles, deux navires-citernes : le plus lourd échange entre les États-Unis et l'Iran depuis plus d'un mois

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation Around the Strait of Hormuz
segments.tr: ## Une nette escalade autour du détroit d'Ormuz

segments.src: Tensions between the United States and Iran flared sharply this week in what analysts describe as the most intense military exchange between the two sides in more than a month.
segments.tr: Les tensions entre les États-Unis et l'Iran se sont vivement intensifiées cette semaine lors de ce que les analystes décrivent comme l'échange militaire le plus intense entre les deux parties depuis plus d'un mois.

segments.src: According to statements from defense officials, US forces conducted a wide-ranging series of strikes against sites linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports citing close to 100 separate targets.
segments.tr: Selon des déclarations de responsables de la défense, les forces américaines ont mené une série de frappes d'envergure contre des sites liés au Corps des gardiens de la Révolution islamique (CGRI) de l'Iran près du détroit d'Ormuz, les rapports faisant état de près de 100 cibles distinctes.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the operation say the strikes notably included, for the first time in this round of hostilities, vessels identified as Iranian government-affiliated tankers.
segments.tr: Des responsables familiers avec l'opération affirment que les frappes comprenaient notamment, pour la première fois dans cette série d'hostilités, des navires identifiés comme des pétroliers affiliés au gouvernement iranien.

segments.src: The inclusion of maritime targets marks a departure from previous exchanges, which had largely focused on land-based military infrastructure, and has drawn attention from energy markets and shipping industry observers given the strait's role as a critical corridor for global oil transit.
segments.tr: L'inclusion de cibles maritimes marque un changement par rapport aux échanges précédents, qui s'étaient principalement concentrés sur l'infrastructure militaire terrestre, et a attiré l'attention des marchés de l'énergie et des observateurs de l'industrie du transport maritime étant donné le rôle du détroit en tant que corridor critique pour le transit mondial du pétrole.

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## La réponse de l'Iran

segments.src: In the hours that followed, Iranian forces reportedly launched a combination of ballistic missiles and drones toward US-linked military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: Dans les heures qui ont suivi, les forces iraniennes auraient lancé une combinaison de missiles balistiques et de drones vers des installations militaires liées aux États-Unis en Jordanie, au Koweït et à Bahreïn.

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.
segments.tr: Des responsables régionaux ont indiqué que des systèmes de défense aérienne avaient été activés en réponse, bien que les détails complets du résultat, y compris les dommages ou les victimes, n'aient pas été vérifiés de manière indépendante au moment de la rédaction.

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: Les médias d'État iraniens ont qualifié la réponse de rétaliation, la présentant comme une défense de la souveraineté nationale, tandis que les responsables américains ont décrit leurs frappes initiales comme des actions ciblées contre des infrastructures militaires qui, selon eux, ont été utilisées pour menacer la navigation et la stabilité régionale.

segments.src: As with prior escalations, both sides' public accounts diverge, and independent confirmation of specific claims remains limited.
segments.tr: Comme lors des escalades précédentes, les comptes rendus publics des deux camps divergent et la confirmation indépendante d'affirmations spécifiques reste limitée.

segments.src: ## Why This Round Feels Different
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ce cycle semble différent

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:
segments.tr: Les analystes soulignent deux facteurs qui distinguent cet échange des précédents depuis la fin juillet :

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **Échelle du ciblage.** Le chiffre rapporté d'environ 100 sites représente une expansion significative par rapport aux cycles précédents, qui impliquaient généralement un ensemble de cibles plus restreint.

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **Dimension maritime.** Frapper des pétroliers liés au gouvernement introduit un nouveau front, qui touche directement à la liberté de navigation à travers le détroit d'Ormuz, une voie navigable par laquelle transit une part substantielle du pétrole maritime mondial.

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: Les gouvernements régionaux, y compris ceux abritant les bases prétendument visées par la réponse de l'Iran, ont appelé à la retenue et exhorté les deux parties à éviter toute nouvelle escalade.

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: Les canaux diplomatiques, y compris ceux impliquant des médiateurs du Golfe, seraient actifs, bien qu'aucun cadre de cessez-le-feu n'ait été publiquement confirmé.

segments.src: ## Market and Regional Ripple Effects
segments.tr: ## Effets d'entraînement sur le marché et la région

segments.src: Energy markets moved on the news, with oil prices seeing renewed volatility amid concerns over potential disruptions to shipping through Hormuz, a chokepoint that has repeatedly drawn global attention during past periods of US-Iran tension.
segments.tr: Les marchés de l'énergie ont réagi à la nouvelle, les prix du pétrole connaissant une volatilité renouvelée en raison des craintes concernant des perturbations potentielles du transport maritime à travers Ormuz, un point d'étranglement qui a attiré à plusieurs reprises l'attention mondiale lors de périodes passées de tension entre les États-Unis et l'Iran.

segments.src: Shipping insurers and logistics firms operating in the Gulf are reportedly reassessing risk premiums for vessels transiting the strait.
segments.tr: Les assureurs maritimes et les entreprises de logistique opérant dans le Golfe réévalueraient les primes de risque pour les navires transitant par le détroit.

segments.src: Regional capitals, wary of being drawn further into the confrontation, have emphasized that their territories and bases should not become recurring flashpoints.
segments.tr: Les capitales régionales, soucieuses de ne pas être entraînées davantage dans la confrontation, ont souligné que leurs territoires et bases ne devaient pas devenir des foyers de tension récurrents.

segments.src: Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan have not issued unified public statements beyond confirming that air defense protocols were activated.
segments.tr: Le Koweït, Bahreïn et la Jordanie n'ont pas publié de déclarations publiques unifiées au-delà de la confirmation que des protocoles de défense aérienne avaient été activés.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: With both Washington and Tehran signaling they view their recent actions as proportionate responses rather than the opening moves of a broader campaign, attention now turns to whether this exchange represents a peak or merely a pause.
segments.tr: Alors que Washington et Téhéran signalent tous deux qu'ils considèrent leurs actions récentes comme des réponses proportionnées plutôt que comme les premiers mouvements d'une campagne plus vaste, l'attention se tourne désormais vers la question de savoir si cet échange représente un pic ou simplement une pause.

segments.tr: Les indicateurs clés à surveiller comprennent :

segments.src: - Whether shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continues without further incident
segments.tr: - Si le trafic maritime à travers le détroit d'Ormuz se poursuit sans nouvel incident

segments.src: - Any statements from Gulf Cooperation Council members regarding regional security coordination
segments.tr: - Toutes déclarations des membres du Conseil de coopération du Golfe concernant la coordination de la sécurité régionale

segments.src: - Diplomatic signals from Washington and Tehran in the coming days
segments.tr: - Les signaux diplomatiques de Washington et de Téhéran dans les jours à venir

segments.src: As with previous flare-ups, the situation remains fluid, and official casualty figures, damage assessments and strategic intentions on both sides are likely to be revised as more verified information becomes available.
segments.tr: Comme lors des flambées précédentes, la situation reste fluide, et les chiffres officiels des victimes, les évaluations des dégâts et les intentions stratégiques des deux côtés seront probablement révisés à mesure que des informations plus vérifiées seront disponibles.

in.title: 100 Target, Dua Kapal Tanker: Di Balik Pertukaran Serangan Terberat AS-Iran dalam Lebih dari Sebulan

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation Around the Strait of Hormuz
segments.tr: ## Eskalasi Tajam di Sekitar Selat Hormuz

segments.src: Tensions between the United States and Iran flared sharply this week in what analysts describe as the most intense military exchange between the two sides in more than a month.
segments.tr: Ketegangan antara Amerika Serikat dan Iran meningkat tajam minggu ini dalam apa yang digambarkan oleh para analis sebagai pertukaran militer paling intens antara kedua belah pihak dalam lebih dari sebulan.

segments.src: According to statements from defense officials, US forces conducted a wide-ranging series of strikes against sites linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports citing close to 100 separate targets.
segments.tr: Menurut pernyataan dari pejabat pertahanan, pasukan AS melakukan serangkaian serangan luas terhadap situs-situs yang terkait dengan Korps Garda Revolusi Islam (IRGC) Iran di dekat Selat Hormuz, dengan laporan menyebutkan hampir 100 target terpisah.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the operation say the strikes notably included, for the first time in this round of hostilities, vessels identified as Iranian government-affiliated tankers.
segments.tr: Pejabat yang mengetahui operasi tersebut mengatakan bahwa serangan tersebut secara khusus mencakup, untuk pertama kalinya dalam putaran permusuhan ini, kapal-kapal yang diidentifikasi sebagai kapal tanker yang berafiliasi dengan pemerintah Iran.

segments.src: The inclusion of maritime targets marks a departure from previous exchanges, which had largely focused on land-based military infrastructure, and has drawn attention from energy markets and shipping industry observers given the strait's role as a critical corridor for global oil transit.
segments.tr: Dimasukkannya target maritim menandai perubahan dari pertukaran sebelumnya, yang sebagian besar berfokus pada infrastruktur militer berbasis darat, dan telah menarik perhatian dari pasar energi serta pengamat industri pelayaran mengingat peran selat tersebut sebagai koridor penting bagi transit minyak global.

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## Tanggapan Iran

segments.src: In the hours that followed, Iranian forces reportedly launched a combination of ballistic missiles and drones toward US-linked military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa jam setelahnya, pasukan Iran dilaporkan meluncurkan kombinasi rudal balistik dan drone ke arah instalasi militer yang terkait dengan AS di Yordania, Kuwait, dan Bahrain.

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.
segments.tr: Pejabat regional mengatakan sistem pertahanan udara diaktifkan sebagai tanggapan, meskipun rincian lengkap mengenai hasilnya, termasuk kerusakan atau korban jiwa, belum diverifikasi secara independen pada saat penulisan ini.

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: Media pemerintah Iran mengkarakterisasi tanggapan tersebut sebagai tindakan balasan, membingkainya sebagai pembelaan kedaulatan nasional, sementara pejabat AS menggambarkan serangan awal mereka sebagai tindakan terarah terhadap infrastruktur militer yang menurut mereka telah digunakan untuk mengancam pelayaran dan stabilitas regional.

segments.src: As with prior escalations, both sides' public accounts diverge, and independent confirmation of specific claims remains limited.
segments.tr: Seperti eskalasi sebelumnya, laporan publik dari kedua belah pihak berbeda, dan konfirmasi independen atas klaim-klaim spesifik masih terbatas.

segments.src: ## Why This Round Feels Different
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Putaran Ini Terasa Berbeda

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:
segments.tr: Para analis menunjuk pada dua faktor yang membedakan pertukaran ini dari yang sebelumnya sejak akhir Juli:

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **Skala penargetan.** Angka yang dilaporkan sekitar 100 situs mewakili perluasan yang signifikan dibandingkan dengan putaran sebelumnya, yang biasanya melibatkan serangkaian target yang lebih sempit.

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **Dimensi maritim.** Menyerang kapal tanker yang terkait dengan pemerintah memperkenalkan front baru, yang secara langsung menyentuh kebebasan navigasi melalui Selat Hormuz, jalur air yang dilalui sebagian besar minyak dunia melalui laut.

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: Pemerintah regional, termasuk mereka yang menjadi tuan rumah pangkalan yang dilaporkan menjadi target tanggapan Iran, telah menyerukan penahanan diri dan mendesak kedua belah pihak untuk menghindari eskalasi lebih lanjut.

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: Saluran diplomatik, termasuk yang melibatkan mediator Teluk, dikatakan aktif, meskipun tidak ada kerangka kerja gencatan senjata yang dikonfirmasi secara publik.

segments.src: ## Market and Regional Ripple Effects
segments.tr: ## Efek Domino Pasar dan Regional

segments.src: Energy markets moved on the news, with oil prices seeing renewed volatility amid concerns over potential disruptions to shipping through Hormuz, a chokepoint that has repeatedly drawn global attention during past periods of US-Iran tension.
segments.tr: Pasar energi bergerak merespons berita tersebut, dengan harga minyak mengalami volatilitas baru di tengah kekhawatiran atas potensi gangguan pada pelayaran melalui Hormuz, titik sempit yang berulang kali menarik perhatian global selama periode ketegangan AS-Iran di masa lalu.

segments.src: Shipping insurers and logistics firms operating in the Gulf are reportedly reassessing risk premiums for vessels transiting the strait.
segments.tr: Perusahaan asuransi pelayaran dan logistik yang beroperasi di Teluk dilaporkan sedang menilai kembali premi risiko untuk kapal-kapal yang melintasi selat tersebut.

segments.src: Regional capitals, wary of being drawn further into the confrontation, have emphasized that their territories and bases should not become recurring flashpoints.
segments.tr: Ibu kota regional, yang waspada terseret lebih jauh ke dalam konfrontasi, telah menekankan bahwa wilayah dan pangkalan mereka tidak boleh menjadi titik api yang berulang.

segments.src: Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan have not issued unified public statements beyond confirming that air defense protocols were activated.
segments.tr: Kuwait, Bahrain, dan Yordania belum mengeluarkan pernyataan publik terpadu selain mengonfirmasi bahwa protokol pertahanan udara telah diaktifkan.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Diperhatikan Selanjutnya

segments.src: With both Washington and Tehran signaling they view their recent actions as proportionate responses rather than the opening moves of a broader campaign, attention now turns to whether this exchange represents a peak or merely a pause.
segments.tr: Dengan Washington dan Teheran sama-sama memberi sinyal bahwa mereka memandang tindakan terbaru mereka sebagai tanggapan yang proporsional daripada langkah awal kampanye yang lebih luas, perhatian kini beralih pada apakah pertukaran ini mewakili puncak atau sekadar jeda.

segments.src: Key indicators to watch include:
segments.tr: Indikator utama yang harus diperhatikan meliputi:

segments.src: - Whether shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continues without further incident
segments.tr: - Apakah lalu lintas pelayaran melalui Selat Hormuz berlanjut tanpa insiden lebih lanjut

segments.src: - Any statements from Gulf Cooperation Council members regarding regional security coordination
segments.tr: - Pernyataan apa pun dari anggota Dewan Kerja Sama Teluk mengenai koordinasi keamanan regional

segments.src: - Diplomatic signals from Washington and Tehran in the coming days
segments.tr: - Sinyal diplomatik dari Washington dan Teheran dalam beberapa hari mendatang

segments.src: As with previous flare-ups, the situation remains fluid, and official casualty figures, damage assessments and strategic intentions on both sides are likely to be revised as more verified information becomes available.
segments.tr: Seperti gejolak sebelumnya, situasi tetap cair, dan angka korban resmi, penilaian kerusakan, serta niat strategis di kedua belah pihak kemungkinan akan direvisi seiring tersedianya informasi yang lebih terverifikasi.

segments.src: Readers are encouraged to follow updates from established wire services for the latest confirmed developments.
segments.tr: Pembaca disarankan untuk mengikuti pembaruan dari kantor berita resmi untuk perkembangan terbaru yang terkonfirmasi.

ja.title: 100の標的、2隻のタンカー：1ヶ月以上で最も激しい米イラン間の応酬の内幕

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation Around the Strait of Hormuz
segments.tr: ## ホルムズ海峡周辺での急激な緊張の高まり

segments.src: Tensions between the United States and Iran flared sharply this week in what analysts describe as the most intense military exchange between the two sides in more than a month.
segments.tr: 今週、米国とイランの間の緊張が急激に高まった。アナリストらは、これを過去1ヶ月以上で両陣営間の最も激しい軍事的な応酬であると評している。

segments.src: According to statements from defense officials, US forces conducted a wide-ranging series of strikes against sites linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports citing close to 100 separate targets.
segments.tr: 国防当局の声明によると、米軍はホルムズ海峡近郊で、イランのイスラム革命防衛隊（IRGC）に関連する施設に対して広範囲にわたる一連の攻撃を実施した。報告によれば、標的は100箇所近くに及ぶという。

segments.src: Officials familiar with the operation say the strikes notably included, for the first time in this round of hostilities, vessels identified as Iranian government-affiliated tankers.
segments.tr: 作戦に詳しい当局者によると、今回の敵対行為において特筆すべき点として、初めてイラン政府関連と特定されたタンカーが攻撃対象に含まれていた。

segments.src: The inclusion of maritime targets marks a departure from previous exchanges, which had largely focused on land-based military infrastructure, and has drawn attention from energy markets and shipping industry observers given the strait's role as a critical corridor for global oil transit.
segments.tr: 海上目標が含まれたことは、主に陸上の軍事インフラに焦点を当てていたこれまでの応酬からの転換を意味する。ホルムズ海峡が世界の石油輸送における重要な回廊であることから、エネルギー市場や海運業界の監視者たちから注目を集めている。

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## イランの反応

segments.src: In the hours that followed, Iranian forces reportedly launched a combination of ballistic missiles and drones toward US-linked military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: その後の数時間で、イラン軍はヨルダン、クウェート、バーレーンにある米軍関連施設に向けて、弾道ミサイルとドローンを組み合わせて発射したと報じられている。

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.
segments.tr: 地域の当局者は、これを受けて防空システムが作動したと述べたが、執筆時点では、被害や死傷者を含む結果の詳細は独自に検証されていない。

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: イランの国営メディアはこの対応を報復的なものと位置づけ、国家主権の防衛であると主張した。一方、米当局は当初の攻撃について、海運や地域の安定を脅かすために使用されていると主張する軍事インフラに対する標的を絞った行動であると説明した。

segments.src: As with prior escalations, both sides' public accounts diverge, and independent confirmation of specific claims remains limited.
segments.tr: これまでの緊張の高まりと同様に、両陣営の公式見解は食い違っており、特定の主張に関する独立した確認は依然として限られている。

segments.src: ## Why This Round Feels Different
segments.tr: ## 今回の応酬が異質である理由

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:
segments.tr: アナリストらは、7月下旬以降のこれまでの応酬と今回を区別する2つの要因を指摘している：

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **標的の規模。** 報告されている約100箇所という数字は、通常より限定的な標的セットを対象としていた以前の応酬と比較して、大幅な拡大を意味する。

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **海上の側面。** 政府関連のタンカーを攻撃したことは新たな戦線を開くものであり、世界の海上石油輸送の相当部分が通過する水路であるホルムズ海峡を通じた航行の自由という問題に直接触れるものである。

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: イランの報復攻撃の標的となったとされる基地を抱える国々を含む地域の政府は、自制を求め、双方に対してこれ以上のエスカレーションを避けるよう促している。

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: 湾岸諸国の仲介者を含む外交ルートが活発に動いていると言われているが、停戦の枠組みは公に確認されていない。

segments.src: ## Market and Regional Ripple Effects
segments.tr: ## 市場と地域への波及効果

segments.src: Energy markets moved on the news, with oil prices seeing renewed volatility amid concerns over potential disruptions to shipping through Hormuz, a chokepoint that has repeatedly drawn global attention during past periods of US-Iran tension.
segments.tr: エネルギー市場はこのニュースに反応し、過去の米イラン緊張期にも繰り返し注目を集めてきたチョークポイントであるホルムズ海峡を通じた輸送が混乱する懸念から、原油価格は再び不安定な動きを見せた。

segments.src: Shipping insurers and logistics firms operating in the Gulf are reportedly reassessing risk premiums for vessels transiting the strait.
segments.tr: 湾岸地域で活動する海運保険会社や物流企業は、海峡を通過する船舶のリスクプレミアムを再評価していると報じられている。

segments.src: Regional capitals, wary of being drawn further into the confrontation, have emphasized that their territories and bases should not become recurring flashpoints.
segments.tr: 対立にこれ以上巻き込まれることを警戒する地域の首都は、自国の領土や基地が繰り返しの火種となるべきではないと強調している。

segments.src: Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan have not issued unified public statements beyond confirming that air defense protocols were activated.
segments.tr: クウェート、バーレーン、ヨルダンは、防空プロトコルが作動したことを確認する以上の統一された公式声明は出していない。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の注目点

segments.src: With both Washington and Tehran signaling they view their recent actions as proportionate responses rather than the opening moves of a broader campaign, attention now turns to whether this exchange represents a peak or merely a pause.
segments.tr: ワシントンとテヘランの双方が、最近の行動をより広範なキャンペーンの開始ではなく、均衡のとれた対応であると示唆している中、今回の応酬がピークなのか、それとも単なる一時停止なのかに注目が集まっている。

segments.src: Key indicators to watch include:
segments.tr: 注目すべき重要な指標は以下の通り：

segments.src: - Whether shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continues without further incident
segments.tr: - ホルムズ海峡を通る海運交通が、これ以上の事件なく継続するかどうか

segments.src: - Any statements from Gulf Cooperation Council members regarding regional security coordination
segments.tr: - 地域の安全保障調整に関する湾岸協力会議（GCC）加盟国からの声明

segments.src: - Diplomatic signals from Washington and Tehran in the coming days
segments.tr: - 今後の数日間におけるワシントンとテヘランからの外交的シグナル

segments.src: As with previous flare-ups, the situation remains fluid, and official casualty figures, damage assessments and strategic intentions on both sides are likely to be revised as more verified information becomes available.
segments.tr: これまでの緊張の高まりと同様に、状況は流動的であり、公式の死傷者数、被害評価、双方の戦略的意図は、より検証された情報が入手可能になるにつれて修正される可能性が高い。

segments.src: Readers are encouraged to follow updates from established wire services for the latest confirmed developments.
segments.tr: 読者は、最新の確認された進展について、確立された通信社の更新情報をフォローすることを推奨する。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes zu beobachten ist

segments.src: With both Washington and Tehran signaling they view their recent actions as proportionate responses rather than the opening moves of a broader campaign, attention now turns to whether this exchange represents a peak or merely a pause.
segments.tr: Da sowohl Washington als auch Teheran signalisieren, dass sie ihre jüngsten Aktionen als verhältnismäßige Reaktionen und nicht als Auftakt zu einer breiteren Kampagne betrachten, richtet sich die Aufmerksamkeit nun darauf, ob dieser Schlagabtausch einen Höhepunkt oder lediglich eine Pause darstellt.

segments.tr: Wichtige Indikatoren, auf die man achten sollte, umfassen:

segments.tr: - Ob der Schifffahrtsverkehr durch die Straße von Hormus ohne weitere Zwischenfälle fortgesetzt wird

segments.tr: - Etwaige Erklärungen von Mitgliedern des Golf-Kooperationsrates bezüglich der regionalen Sicherheitskoordination

vi.title: 100 Mục tiêu, Hai Tàu chở dầu: Bên trong Cuộc đụng độ Nặng nề nhất giữa Mỹ và Iran trong Hơn một tháng

segments.src: ## A Sharp Escalation Around the Strait of Hormuz
segments.tr: ## Sự leo thang sắc bén quanh Eo biển Hormuz

segments.src: Tensions between the United States and Iran flared sharply this week in what analysts describe as the most intense military exchange between the two sides in more than a month.
segments.tr: Căng thẳng giữa Hoa Kỳ và Iran đã bùng phát mạnh mẽ trong tuần này trong điều mà các nhà phân tích mô tả là cuộc trao đổi quân sự dữ dội nhất giữa hai bên trong hơn một tháng.

segments.src: According to statements from defense officials, US forces conducted a wide-ranging series of strikes against sites linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports citing close to 100 separate targets.
segments.tr: Theo các tuyên bố từ các quan chức quốc phòng, lực lượng Mỹ đã thực hiện một loạt các cuộc tấn công diện rộng nhằm vào các địa điểm liên quan đến Lực lượng Vệ binh Cách mạng Hồi giáo Iran (IRGC) gần Eo biển Hormuz, với các báo cáo trích dẫn gần 100 mục tiêu riêng biệt.

segments.src: Officials familiar with the operation say the strikes notably included, for the first time in this round of hostilities, vessels identified as Iranian government-affiliated tankers.
segments.tr: Các quan chức quen thuộc với chiến dịch cho biết các cuộc tấn công đáng chú ý bao gồm, lần đầu tiên trong đợt thù địch này, các tàu được xác định là tàu chở dầu liên kết với chính phủ Iran.

segments.src: The inclusion of maritime targets marks a departure from previous exchanges, which had largely focused on land-based military infrastructure, and has drawn attention from energy markets and shipping industry observers given the strait's role as a critical corridor for global oil transit.
segments.tr: Việc bao gồm các mục tiêu hàng hải đánh dấu một sự khởi đầu so với các cuộc trao đổi trước đây, vốn phần lớn tập trung vào cơ sở hạ tầng quân sự trên đất liền, và đã thu hút sự chú ý từ các thị trường năng lượng và các nhà quan sát ngành vận tải biển do vai trò của eo biển này là hành lang quan trọng đối với quá trình quá cảnh dầu mỏ toàn cầu.

segments.src: ## Iran's Response
segments.tr: ## Phản ứng của Iran

segments.src: In the hours that followed, Iranian forces reportedly launched a combination of ballistic missiles and drones toward US-linked military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: Trong những giờ sau đó, các lực lượng Iran được cho là đã phóng một tổ hợp tên lửa đạn đạo và máy bay không người lái về phía các cơ sở quân sự liên kết với Mỹ ở Jordan, Kuwait và Bahrain.

segments.src: Regional officials said air defense systems were activated in response, though full details of the outcome, including any damage or casualties, have not been independently verified at the time of writing.
segments.tr: Các quan chức khu vực cho biết hệ thống phòng không đã được kích hoạt để đáp trả, mặc dù toàn bộ chi tiết về kết quả, bao gồm bất kỳ thiệt hại hoặc thương vong nào, chưa được xác minh độc lập tại thời điểm viết bài.

segments.src: Iranian state media characterized the response as retaliatory, framing it as a defense of national sovereignty, while US officials described their initial strikes as targeted actions against military infrastructure they say has been used to threaten shipping and regional stability.
segments.tr: Truyền thông nhà nước Iran mô tả phản ứng này là mang tính trả đũa, đóng khung nó như một sự bảo vệ chủ quyền quốc gia, trong khi các quan chức Mỹ mô tả các cuộc tấn công ban đầu của họ là các hành động có mục tiêu chống lại cơ sở hạ tầng quân sự mà họ cho là đã được sử dụng để đe dọa hoạt động vận chuyển và sự ổn định khu vực.

segments.src: As with prior escalations, both sides' public accounts diverge, and independent confirmation of specific claims remains limited.
segments.tr: Giống như các cuộc leo thang trước đó, các tài khoản công khai của cả hai bên khác nhau và việc xác nhận độc lập các tuyên bố cụ thể vẫn còn hạn chế.

segments.src: ## Why This Round Feels Different
segments.tr: ## Tại sao Vòng này Cảm thấy Khác biệt

segments.src: Analysts point to two factors that distinguish this exchange from earlier ones since late July:
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích chỉ ra hai yếu tố phân biệt cuộc trao đổi này với các cuộc trao đổi trước đó kể từ cuối tháng 7:

segments.src: - **Scale of targeting.** The reported figure of roughly 100 sites represents a significant expansion compared to previous rounds, which typically involved a narrower set of targets.
segments.tr: - **Quy mô nhắm mục tiêu.** Con số được báo cáo là khoảng 100 địa điểm thể hiện sự mở rộng đáng kể so với các vòng trước, vốn thường liên quan đến một tập hợp các mục tiêu hẹp hơn.

segments.src: - **Maritime dimension.** Striking government-linked tankers introduces a new front, one that touches directly on freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, a waterway through which a substantial share of the world's seaborne oil passes.
segments.tr: - **Chiều1 hướng hàng hải.** Tấn công các tàu chở dầu liên kết với chính phủ giới thiệu một mặt trận mới, một mặt trận chạm trực tiếp vào tự do hàng hải qua Eo biển Hormuz, một tuyến đường thủy mà qua đó một phần đáng kể dầu vận chuyển đường biển của thế giới đi qua.

segments.src: Regional governments, including those hosting the bases reportedly targeted by Iran's response, have called for restraint and urged both sides to avoid further escalation.
segments.tr: Các chính phủ khu vực, bao gồm cả những quốc gia đăng cai các căn cứ bị báo cáo là mục tiêu bởi phản ứng của Iran, đã kêu gọi kiềm chế và thúc giục cả hai bên tránh leo thang hơn nữa.

segments.src: Diplomatic channels, including those involving Gulf mediators, are said to be active, though no ceasefire framework has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: Các kênh ngoại giao, bao gồm cả những kênh liên quan đến các nhà trung gian vùng Vịnh, được cho là đang hoạt động, mặc dù chưa có khuôn khổ lệnh ngừng bắn nào được công khai xác nhận.

segments.src: ## Market and Regional Ripple Effects
segments.tr: ## Hiệu ứng gợn sóng thị trường và khu vực

segments.src: Energy markets moved on the news, with oil prices seeing renewed volatility amid concerns over potential disruptions to shipping through Hormuz, a chokepoint that has repeatedly drawn global attention during past periods of US-Iran tension.
segments.tr: Thị trường năng lượng đã chuyển động theo tin tức, với giá dầu chứng kiến sự biến động mới trong bối cảnh lo ngại về khả năng gián đoạn vận chuyển qua Hormuz, một điểm nghẽn đã nhiều lần thu hút sự chú ý toàn cầu trong các thời kỳ căng thẳng Mỹ-Iran trước đây.

segments.src: Shipping insurers and logistics firms operating in the Gulf are reportedly reassessing risk premiums for vessels transiting the strait.
segments.tr: Các công ty bảo hiểm vận tải biển và các công ty hậu cần hoạt động ở Vùng Vịnh được cho là đang đánh giá lại phí bảo hiểm rủi ro cho các tàu quá cảnh qua eo biển.

segments.src: Regional capitals, wary of being drawn further into the confrontation, have emphasized that their territories and bases should not become recurring flashpoints.
segments.tr: Các thủ đô khu vực, thận trọng về việc bị lôi kéo sâu hơn vào cuộc đối đầu, đã nhấn mạnh rằng lãnh thổ và căn cứ của họ không nên trở thành điểm nóng định kỳ.

segments.src: Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan have not issued unified public statements beyond confirming that air defense protocols were activated.
segments.tr: Kuwait, Bahrain và Jordan chưa đưa ra các tuyên bố công khai thống nhất ngoài việc xác nhận rằng các giao thức phòng không đã được kích hoạt.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Những gì cần xem tiếp theo

segments.src: With both Washington and Tehran signaling they view their recent actions as proportionate responses rather than the opening moves of a broader campaign, attention now turns to whether this exchange represents a peak or merely a pause.
segments.tr: Với cả Washington và Tehran ra hiệu rằng họ xem các hành động gần đây của họ là phản ứng tương xứng hơn là các bước mở đầu của một chiến dịch rộng lớn hơn, sự chú ý bây giờ chuyển sang việc liệu cuộc trao đổi này đại diện cho mức đỉnh hay chỉ là một sự tạm dừng.

segments.src: Key indicators to watch include:
segments.tr: Các chỉ số chính cần theo dõi bao gồm:

segments.src: - Whether shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continues without further incident
segments.tr: - Liệu lưu lượng vận chuyển qua Eo biển Hormuz có tiếp tục mà không có sự cố nào khác không

segments.src: - Any statements from Gulf Cooperation Council members regarding regional security coordination
segments.tr: - Bất kỳ tuyên bố nào từ các thành viên Hội đồng Hợp tác Vùng Vịnh liên quan đến việc phối hợp an ninh khu vực

segments.src: - Diplomatic signals from Washington and Tehran in the coming days
segments.tr: - Tín hiệu ngoại giao từ Washington và Tehran trong những ngày tới

segments.src: As with previous flare-ups, the situation remains fluid, and official casualty figures, damage assessments and strategic intentions on both sides are likely to be revised as more verified information becomes available.
segments.tr: Giống như các đợt bùng phát trước đây, tình hình vẫn còn nhiều biến động và các số liệu thương vong chính thức, đánh giá thiệt hại và ý định chiến lược ở cả hai bên có thể sẽ được sửa đổi khi có thêm thông tin được xác minh.
